origin: Own deterministic mutation-selection study on anonymous binary strings grouped solely by Hamming distance from one abstract reference state. No biological sequence, organism, phenotype engineering, intervention or experimental measurement is supplied or requested. Sequence length is a mathematical state-space parameter; the population is infinite throughout. Inputs are exact constructed rates.
model: For each L in[8,16,32], Hamming class k ranges0..L. Continuous-time independent symmetric single-bit mutation has per-bit rate mu=U/L, total outgoing rate U. Use COLUMN vectors and Q[k+1,k]=mu*(L-k),Q[k-1,k]=mu*k,Q[k,k]=-U, with missing boundary entries omitted and all other entries0. Malthusian selection gives fitness s=1 to class0 and0 to all others. A=Q+s*e0*e0^T. The deterministic normalized population obeys x_prime=A*x-phi*x,phi=s*x0,sum x=1. Study U in[0.4,1,2] with the same fixed time unit. This continuous-time additive selection/mutation model is defined here; a discrete-generation copying matrix is a different model.
spectral_construction: Derive the reversible mutation weights pi_k=binomial(L,k)/2^L and the exact diagonal similarity between A and a REAL SYMMETRIC tridiagonal H. Construct every full H and retain its actual complete registered symmetric eigendecomposition for all9(L,U)cases. Retain full registered matrix products verifying H times its actual top eigenvector, with the full vector and residual; do not substitute a copied answer for the returned vector. Similarity is not an orthogonal change of the population norm. Derive how the principal eigenvector determines the normalized right population distribution x and the normalized left-times-right ancestral distribution a. Retain every class probability of both distributions in tool observations, not only class0. Overall eigenvector signs are arbitrary and must cancel from normalized scientific outputs.
ancestry_definition: For a positive right Perron vector r and left Perron vector l of A, normalize l^T*r=1 and define ancestral weights a_k=l_k*r_k; population weights are x_k=r_k/sum r. These describe different sampling schemes in this deterministic equilibrium. Derive a0=partial lambda/partial s at fixed L,U using the correct eigenvalue derivative, where lambda is the leading growth eigenvalue. Establish the population identity lambda=s*x0 and a separate stationarity identity for mean Hamming fraction. Do not reinterpret a as an independent current-population census or square x without the reversible weights.
precision_and_full_inverse_identity: At large L above the limiting threshold, the leading eigenvalue is exponentially small. Derive an exact scalar secular equation for its unique positive root from the rank-one perturbation of the binary mutation operator. Verify it independently against the full registered spectra and population/ancestry calculations, and use a numerically stable scaled root or adequately controlled bracket to resolve the requested tiny quantities. A binary64 eigenvalue rounded near0 is not evidence of exact extinction. Report 2^L*x0 and 2^L*a0 at U2 rather than unscaled tiny values. Report unscaled x0,a0 at U0.4and1; report the mean Hamming fraction and gap between the largest two full symmetric eigenvalues for every case. Full distributions still need normalization and nonnegativity checks. Do not impose a probability sum on the list of results for different L or U.
finite_and_infinite_length: First use irreducibility/Perron theory to decide positivity, uniqueness and analytic dependence for every FINITE L and U>0. Then take L to infinity holding TOTAL mutation U and selection s=1 fixed. Derive the limiting master-population fraction at U0.4,1,2, the one-sided limiting ancestral-master fractions as U approaches1from below/above AFTER the Llimit, and limiting mean Hamming fraction below/above1. Derive the leading exponential coefficients lim 2^L*x0 and lim 2^L*a0 at U2. Finally at the exactly critical U1 derive lim L*x0, lim a0 and lim mean(k/L). These critical limits must be obtained from a controlled secular/binomial asymptotic argument, not a fit to three finite lengths. Explain why taking the critical parameter exactly can differ from taking a one-sided parameter limit after L tends to infinity. Finite L and finite population size are different concepts; no stochastic loss-of-alleles claim is justified by this model.

interpretation_proposals.A: Perron positivity at finite length is compatible with an exponentially small master population.
interpretation_proposals.B: The ancestral class distribution is always the same as the population class distribution.
interpretation_proposals.C: The selection derivative of growth measures ancestral weighting and need not equal the current master fraction.
interpretation_proposals.D: An eigenvalue smaller than an absolute plotting tolerance establishes exact finite-length extinction.
interpretation_proposals.E: The infinite-length limit can be nonanalytic although every finite-length positive-mutation equilibrium is smooth.
interpretation_proposals.F: Keeping per-bit mutation fixed while L grows is the same limiting experiment as keeping total mutation fixed.
interpretation_proposals.G: Critical finite-size scaling and one-sided infinite-size limits require their order of limits to be stated.
interpretation_proposals.H: Finite-length deterministic mutation-selection proves random genetic extinction in a finite population.

reporting: Rows follow L8,16,32. The two-column master/ancestry arrays follow U0.4,1; three-column mean/gap arrays follow U0.4,1,2. Scale both U2master fractions by EXACT2^Lbefore reporting. Numerical absolute tolerance1e-7 on the reported quantities, so a raw tiny value may not replace a scaled one. All probability distributions are nonnegative and normalized. Keep actual full matrices, complete spectra and returned principal-vector handoffs, all class probabilities, the independently solved secular equation and analytic finite/large-L/critical arguments in the trajectory. Formulas may be evaluated with registered numerical tools; binomial weights can be built by a recurrence without a special combinatorial library.
